CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

3. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Collage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Volleyball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and Pattern Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
